gatepoe210.text: Gate: PoE2 1.0 is live (the launch date has passed and an upstream record shows 1.0).

launchcheck.text: The 1.0 date passed 3 days ago and no upstream shows 1.0: confirm the launch state from the allowed sources. ACCEPT: the gate is flipped by hand or a new date is recorded. SOURCE: watch launch no-signal, filed <YYYY-MM-DD>.
